exact_statement: For every Boolean sign f on the uniform m-cube, every surjective parity-input map A:F2^N->F2^m, input translation b and output parity t, F(x)=(-1)^(t.x)f(Ax+b) is actual Boolean, H(F)=H(f), and I(F)=sum_j[q_f(v_j) if t_j=0 else 1-q_f(v_j)]>=M(f), where q_f(v)=P[f(z)!=f(z+v)] and M(f) is the minimum basis sum of min(q_f(v),1-q_f(v)). Equality is attained with N=m. For disjoint Boolean tensor factors M adds exactly, so redundant full-rank parity padding cannot improve beyond the best invertible modulated seed transform and cannot amplify tensor ratios beyond the largest optimized seed ratio. Every redundant physical column can be peeled at zero entropy decrease while retaining an invertible actual Boolean terminal core and exactly subtracting its queried influence. In particular every full-rank parity code with any output modulation of every disjoint point-defect tensor with seed dimensions >=2 satisfies H<=4I. A point defect with r nonzero systematic auxiliaries each replaced by fresh majority-three has dimension m+3r, H=H(f_m)+4r*2^(-m), I=(2m+3r)*2^(-m), mean=1-2^(1-m), and H<=4I. Activation-coding extension: For every actual Boolean g on m uniform bits with mu=Eg>=0, r>=1 fresh point controls, p=2^-r,c=1-mu, and V=1+A_r(g-1), the best full-rank affine parity code with any output-character modulation has exact total influence M(V)=p[T_c(g)+r c], where T_c(g) is the minimum basis sum of min(q_g(v),c) using UNFOLDED directional disagreements. Every optimal code is realized by replacing capped core columns with that column plus the first control unit and retaining all control units. In general folded M(g) cannot replace T_c: a literal has M(g)=0 but M(V)=p(r+1). For every even k>=2 shared bent/spike F from A078 stage3, write a=2^-k,b=2^(-k/2),D=1/4+a/2,C_minus=(1-b-a)/2,C_plus=(1-b+a)/2. Exact directional strata give M(F)=a/2+kD+C_minus=I(F)-a, attained by replacing the selector column by selector+s_1+s_2. For W=1+A_r(F-1), M(W)=p[M(F)+r C_plus]=I(W)-pa. H(F)<4M(F) and H(W)<6M(W), retaining full terminal entropy and all physical core/control influence. Thus every full-rank coded/modulated F has H<4I, every such W has H<6I, and arbitrary joint parity codes of disjoint tensor products of these factors retain H<=6I. No arbitrary-core entropy or repeated-query selector reserve is paid.
